I only hit stupid nobles and crooked merchants, the 'righteous thief' kind, // so don't lump me in with the petty crooks around here. [5]Even what I steal, I hand most of it out to the poor. // [6]Well, sure, sometimes I spend it on myself too, but I was pretty famous back in Baileste, you know that? // [7]But still, treasure or no treasure, maybe I shouldn't have come to a place like this. // I mean, there's nothing to do for fun, nothing at all! [8]Sure, the old geezers are fine as long as they've got booze.
Guess it's about time I made a little money too... // You're heading out now, right? Tell me how it goes later.
See ya.
Haah, isn't there anything fun around here...
Haah, so boooring. I want more of a thrill, you know?
A thrill, is it... // Come to think of it, I heard you were a thief before you came here. Is that true?
Yeah. So?
S-stealing what belongs to others! Have you no sense of guilt!?
None at all.
You...[1] [2]I simply cannot believe it...
I've never once felt the least bit bad about it. // I mean, I only steal from rich nobles and merchants, and the money I steal, I give to poor people.
Even so, stealing is not right! // Money gained by doing wrong can't solve anything!!
